content: The red Prototipo RS shoes are designed for all-day comfort and versatility. They include extra padding on the tongue, heel, and collar, an ONSTEAM anti-microbial lining for moisture and odor control, and a removable contoured cork & EVA foam insole with a perforated footbed. The Black/Red version also emphasizes high-quality craftsmanship inspired by luxury automotive design.
